title: Alias-gate pins for era_gate (5 arrays) and topology.pipe_lane_over silently no-op — the fixture never grows them
evidence:
app/render/spawn_fx_test.odin:130-132 (sfx_no_alias):
	if len(a) == 0 {
		return
	}
app/render/spawn_fx_test.odin:174:
	sfx_no_alias(t, clone.topology.pipe_lane_over, s.topology.pipe_lane_over, ctx, "topology.pipe_lane_over")
app/render/spawn_fx_test.odin:211:
	sfx_no_alias(t, clone.era_gate.ring, s.era_gate.ring, ctx, "era_gate.ring")
app/render/spawn_fx_test.odin:148-149 (the only setup the new gate test performs — no commands, no advance_gate_enabled):
	s.era = 3 // the full kit era: pieces + fiber spools non-empty (the nil trap)
	pp.box_enable(&s, &cat)
core/topology.odin:474 (pipe_lane_over grows ONLY via apply_set_lane / Cmd_Set_Lane):
	append(&t.pipe_lane_over, Lane_Override{pipe = c.pipe, class = c.class, lane = c.lane})
core/era.odin:333 + 143 (era_gate arrays grow ONLY under the gate-enabled branch):
	if state.advance_gate_enabled {
	...
	era_gate_ensure(g, cat, n)
app/main.odin:936 (real runs DO grow era_gate):
	app.state.advance_gate_enabled = true
detail: The gate test applies no commands and never sets advance_gate_enabled, so pipe_lane_over and the era_gate arrays are len-0; the helper skips empties, leaving those shadow_clone lines ungated while real app runs grow both — the exact abort class stays reachable there.
recommended_fix: Make the pins fire: in the gate test set s.advance_gate_enabled = true (step past advance.milestone_window_ticks) and apply one Cmd_Set_Lane via topology_apply_edit before cloning, so era_gate and pipe_lane_over buffers are non-empty when pinned.

title: Economy-leg window math wraps u64 (suite hang) if the terminal_spawn_interval catalog knob drops to <= 5
evidence:
app/render/spawn_fx_test.odin:294:
	interval := u64(cat.balance.terminal_spawn_interval_ticks)
app/render/spawn_fx_test.odin:311:
		lead := base - 5 // inside the 10-tick telegraph lead, like the playtest
data/balance.json:7:
  "terminal_spawn_interval_ticks": 80,
detail: base - 5 underflows u64 when interval <= 5, so the per-window stepping loop bounds at ~2^64 ticks — the leg hangs instead of failing. The knob is data-driven and playtest-tunable; no guard mirrors spawn_fx_predict's interval <= 0 check.
recommended_fix: Guard the leg after reading the interval: fail fast (testing.fatal or panic) when interval <= SPAWN_LEAD_TICKS, mirroring spawn_fx_predict's interval <= 0 early-out.
